analysis.summaryJa: カンマ＋whichは直前の名詞だけでなく、集合の一部、前置詞との関係、性質・状態、さらに直前の出来事全体を受けて注釈できる。何を受けるかは節内の意味と矢印をたどって判断する。
grammarPoints: 数量＋of whichで集合の一部を示す形
前置詞＋whichによる関係の明示
カンマ＋whichが直前の出来事全体を受ける用法
状態・表現を受けるwhich節
visualEvidence: 画像の大きなWHICH受け皿へ名詞・性質・出来事全体の3経路が流れ込む
two of whichとfor whichの専用パネルがある
列車の早着という出来事全体をwhichが受けるミニ問題が示されている
commonTraps: whichを直前の名詞だけに機械的に結び付ける
数量表現でtwo whichなどofを落とす
前置詞を関係節末と前置の両方に置く
文全体を受けるwhichの前のカンマを落とす

questions.prompt: The courier arrived before noon, ------- pleased the customer.

choices.B: what
choices.C: which
choices.D: who

questions.translationJa: 配送業者は正午前に到着し、そのことが顧客を喜ばせました。
questions.explanationJa: whichはcourierという名詞ではなく「正午前に到着した」出来事全体を受けます。

questions.prompt: We tested five prototypes, two ------- failed the heat test.

choices.B: which of
choices.C: of that
choices.D: whose

questions.translationJa: 試作品を5台試験し、そのうち2台が耐熱試験に不合格でした。
questions.explanationJa: 5台の集合のうち2台を示すためtwo of whichを使います。

questions.prompt: The conference room, ------- we paid an additional fee, is on the top floor.

choices.B: for that
choices.C: where for
choices.D: for which

questions.translationJa: 追加料金を支払った会議室は最上階にあります。
questions.explanationJa: pay a fee for the roomのforをwhichの前に置き、for whichとします。

questions.prompt: The system will be offline tonight, ------- means orders cannot be processed.

choices.B: which
choices.C: what
choices.D: where

questions.translationJa: 今夜システムが停止するため、注文を処理できないということになります。
questions.explanationJa: whichは直前のシステム停止という内容全体を受け、meansの主語になります。

questions.prompt: The branch received twelve applications, three ------- were incomplete.

choices.B: which
choices.C: of them which
choices.D: that of

questions.translationJa: 支店は12件の応募を受け取り、そのうち3件は不備がありました。
questions.explanationJa: twelve applicationsという集合の一部をthree of whichで示します。
questions.focus: 集合の一部を示すof which

questions.prompt: Ms. Hill was unusually late, ------- she rarely is.

choices.B: what
choices.C: which
choices.D: who

questions.translationJa: ヒルさんは珍しく遅刻しましたが、彼女が遅れることはめったにありません。
questions.explanationJa: whichはunusually lateという状態を受け、she rarely isの補語に対応します。

questions.prompt: The platform, ------- all reservations are managed, was upgraded.

choices.B: through which
choices.C: through that
choices.D: where through

questions.translationJa: すべての予約を管理するプラットフォームが更新されました。
questions.explanationJa: reservations are managed through the platformの関係をthrough whichで示します。

questions.prompt: We ordered eight chairs, none ------- arrived damaged.

choices.B: of that
choices.C: whose
choices.D: of which

questions.translationJa: 椅子を8脚注文しましたが、破損して届いたものは1脚もありませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: 8脚の集合内でゼロを表すためnone of whichを使います。

questions.prompt: The client approved the revised design, ------- allowed production to begin.

choices.B: what
choices.C: which
choices.D: where

questions.translationJa: 顧客が改訂デザインを承認し、その結果、生産を開始できました。
questions.explanationJa: whichは承認という出来事全体を受け、allowedの主語になります。

questions.prompt: The security procedure, ------- every visitor must comply, is posted at reception.

choices.B: with that
choices.C: whose
choices.D: with which

questions.translationJa: すべての来訪者が従わなければならない警備手順が受付に掲示されています。
questions.explanationJa: comply with the procedureのwithをwhichの前に置いてwith whichとします。
questions.focus: 動詞と結び付く前置詞＋which

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence commenting on an early delivery.

choices.A: The samples arrived early which, surprised the laboratory staff.
choices.B: The samples arrived early, which surprised the laboratory staff.
choices.C: The samples arrived early, that surprised the laboratory staff.
choices.D: The samples arrived early, what surprised the laboratory staff.

questions.translationJa: サンプルが早く到着し、そのことが研究所職員を驚かせました。
questions.explanationJa: 直前の出来事全体への注釈はカンマ＋whichで表します。
questions.focus: 文全体を受けるwhichの句読法

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence describing part of a shipment.

choices.A: The shipment contained ten monitors, four which were cracked.
choices.B: The shipment contained ten monitors, of which four them were cracked.
choices.C: The shipment contained ten monitors, four of that were cracked.
choices.D: The shipment contained ten monitors, four of which were cracked.

questions.translationJa: その配送品にはモニターが10台あり、そのうち4台にひびが入っていました。
questions.explanationJa: 数量fourの後ろにof whichを置いて集合の一部を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a service paid for in advance.

choices.A: The service, for which we paid in advance, begins Monday.
choices.B: The service, which we paid for it in advance, begins Monday.
choices.C: The service, for that we paid in advance, begins Monday.
choices.D: The service, for which we paid for in advance, begins Monday.

questions.translationJa: 前払いしたサービスは月曜日に始まります。
questions.explanationJa: pay for the serviceのforを前置したら、節末にforやitを重ねません。
questions.focus: for whichと前置詞重複回避

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence explaining a consequence of cancellation.

choices.A: The meeting was canceled which, left the room available.
choices.B: The meeting was canceled, that left the room available.
choices.C: The meeting was canceled, which left the room available.
choices.D: The meeting was canceled, which the room left available.

questions.translationJa: 会議が中止され、その結果、部屋が空きました。
questions.explanationJa: whichは会議中止という出来事全体を受け、leftの主語です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence describing none of several bids.

choices.A: We received six bids, none which met the budget.
choices.B: We received six bids, none of them which met the budget.
choices.C: We received six bids, none of that met the budget.
choices.D: We received six bids, none of which met the budget.

questions.translationJa: 入札を6件受け取りましたが、予算内のものは1件もありませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: 集合中のゼロをnone of whichで正確に表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a method used to verify accounts.

choices.A: The method which accounts are verified by it is secure.
choices.B: The method by which accounts are verified is secure.
choices.C: The method by that accounts are verified is secure.
choices.D: The method by which accounts are verified by is secure.

questions.translationJa: アカウントを確認する方法は安全です。
questions.explanationJa: accounts are verified by the methodのbyを関係詞の前に置いてby whichとします。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence commenting on a manager’s state.

choices.A: Ms. Long was confident, that she usually is before presentations.
choices.B: Ms. Long was confident which, she usually is before presentations.
choices.C: Ms. Long was confident, which she usually is before presentations.
choices.D: Ms. Long was confident, which she usually does before presentations.

questions.translationJa: ロングさんは自信に満ちていましたが、発表前はいつもそうです。
questions.explanationJa: whichはconfidentという状態を受け、be動詞isの補語に対応します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence describing most items in a set.

choices.A: The catalog lists twenty courses, most of which are online.
choices.B: The catalog lists twenty courses, most which are online.
choices.C: The catalog lists twenty courses, most of that are online.
choices.D: The catalog lists twenty courses, of which most them are online.

questions.translationJa: カタログには20講座が掲載され、その大半はオンラインです。
questions.explanationJa: 集合の大部分はmost of whichで表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a policy employees objected to.

choices.A: The policy, which several employees objected to it, was revised.
choices.B: The policy, to that several employees objected, was revised.
choices.C: The policy, to which several employees objected to, was revised.
choices.D: The policy, to which several employees objected, was revised.

questions.translationJa: 複数の従業員が反対した方針は改訂されました。
questions.explanationJa: object to the policyのtoをwhichの前に置き、節内で重ねません。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence commenting on a full refund.

choices.A: The hotel issued a full refund, that resolved the complaint.
choices.B: The hotel issued a full refund which, resolved the complaint.
choices.C: The hotel issued a full refund, which resolved the complaint.
choices.D: The hotel issued a full refund, what the complaint resolved.

questions.translationJa: ホテルが全額返金し、そのことで苦情が解決しました。
questions.explanationJa: 返金した出来事全体をwhichが受け、resolvedの主語になります。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The train was delayed, which upset several passengers."

choices.B: The train was upset by several passengers.
choices.C: The passengers were delayed because they upset the train.
choices.D: The train’s delay upset several passengers.

questions.translationJa: 列車の遅延が複数の乗客を不快にさせました。
questions.explanationJa: whichは列車が遅れた出来事全体を受け、その出来事がupsetの原因です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "We examined seven samples, two of which were contaminated."

choices.A: We examined only two contaminated samples.
choices.B: Two of the seven samples we examined were contaminated.
choices.C: All seven samples were free of contamination.
choices.D: Seven of the two samples were contaminated.

questions.translationJa: 検査した7つのサンプルのうち2つが汚染されていました。
questions.explanationJa: two of whichは先行する7つの集合のうち2つを指します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The subscription, for which we paid $200, expires soon."

choices.A: The subscription will pay us $200 soon.
choices.B: We paid for an expiration rather than a subscription.
choices.C: We paid $200 for the subscription, and it expires soon.
choices.D: The subscription expired before we paid anything.

questions.translationJa: その購読に200ドルを支払い、まもなく期限が切れます。
questions.explanationJa: for which I paidはpaid $200 for the subscriptionの語順に戻せます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The store extended its hours, which increased evening sales."

choices.A: Extending the store’s hours increased evening sales.
choices.B: Evening sales forced the store to close earlier.
choices.C: The store reduced its hours after sales increased.
choices.D: The store’s evening sales shortened every hour.

questions.translationJa: 営業時間の延長が夜間売上を増加させました。
questions.explanationJa: whichは営業時間を延長した出来事全体を受け、売上増加の原因を示します。
questions.focus: 出来事全体の因果関係

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The box held six bottles, none of which leaked."

choices.A: All six bottles in the box leaked.
choices.B: Not one of the six bottles in the box leaked.
choices.C: The empty box leaked six times.
choices.D: Only bottles outside the box did not leak.

questions.translationJa: 箱の中の6本のボトルは1本も漏れませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: none of whichは6本の集合の中で漏れたものがゼロであることを示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The portal, through which claims are submitted, is unavailable."

choices.A: The portal submits claims through customers.
choices.B: Claims are unavailable because the portal submitted them.
choices.C: The portal is available only after every claim.
choices.D: Claims are submitted through the portal, but it is unavailable.

questions.translationJa: 請求はそのポータルを通じて提出されますが、現在利用できません。
questions.explanationJa: through whichはthrough the portalという手段関係を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The client accepted every condition, which was unexpected."

choices.A: It was unexpected that the client accepted every condition.
choices.B: The client expected us to reject every condition.
choices.C: Every condition was unexpected by itself.
choices.D: The client accepted only expected conditions.

questions.translationJa: 顧客がすべての条件を受け入れたのは予想外でした。
questions.explanationJa: whichはcondition単体でなく、すべてを受け入れた事実全体を受けます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The team is highly efficient, which it has always been."

choices.B: Efficiency has never described the team.
choices.C: The team has always been highly efficient.
choices.D: The team always measures other groups’ efficiency.

questions.translationJa: そのチームはずっと非常に効率的です。
questions.explanationJa: whichはhighly efficientという状態を受け、has always beenの補語として省略されています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "We own four warehouses, all of which have solar panels."

choices.A: Each of our four warehouses has solar panels.
choices.B: Only one of our warehouses has solar panels.
choices.C: Four solar panels own our warehouses.
choices.D: None of the warehouses uses solar power.

questions.translationJa: 当社の4つの倉庫すべてに太陽光パネルがあります。
questions.explanationJa: all of whichは先行する4倉庫の全てを指します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The deadline was moved forward, which created scheduling problems."

choices.A: Scheduling problems moved the deadline later.
choices.B: Moving the deadline forward created scheduling problems.
choices.C: The deadline solved every scheduling problem.
choices.D: The schedule was created before any deadline existed.

questions.translationJa: 期限の前倒しが日程上の問題を生みました。
questions.explanationJa: whichは期限を前倒しした出来事全体を受け、その結果を述べています。

questions.prompt: The courier delivered every parcel before ten. This pleased the client, ------- had expected delays.

choices.B: that
choices.C: who
choices.D: what

questions.translationJa: 配送業者は全荷物を10時前に届けました。これは遅れを予想していた顧客を喜ばせました。
questions.explanationJa: この空所はclientという人を受けるためwhoです。出来事全体を受けるwhichとの違いを確認します。
questions.focus: 名詞を受けるwhoとの区別

questions.prompt: The courier delivered every parcel before ten, ------- pleased the client.

choices.B: who
choices.C: that
choices.D: where

questions.translationJa: 配送業者は全荷物を10時前に届け、そのことが顧客を喜ばせました。
questions.explanationJa: whichは配達完了という主節全体を受けます。

questions.prompt: We purchased nine tablets for training. Three ------- have already been configured.

choices.B: of that
choices.C: whose
choices.D: of which

questions.translationJa: 研修用にタブレットを9台購入しました。そのうち3台はすでに設定済みです。
questions.explanationJa: 9台の一部をthree of whichで示します。

questions.prompt: A reservation portal went live last month. The portal, ------- customers choose time slots, needs an update.

choices.B: through which
choices.C: through that
choices.D: where through

questions.translationJa: 予約ポータルが先月稼働しました。顧客が時間枠を選ぶそのポータルには更新が必要です。
questions.explanationJa: customers choose slots through the portalの手段関係をthrough whichで表します。

questions.prompt: The vendor reduced the quoted price by 15 percent, ------- made approval easier.

choices.B: what
choices.C: which
choices.D: where

questions.translationJa: 仕入先は見積価格を15％下げ、そのことで承認が容易になりました。
questions.explanationJa: whichは価格を下げた出来事全体を受けます。

questions.prompt: The center has ten meeting rooms. All ------- can be booked online.

choices.B: which
choices.C: of that
choices.D: whose

questions.translationJa: そのセンターには会議室が10室あり、すべてオンライン予約できます。
questions.explanationJa: 先行する10室全部をall of whichで受けます。

questions.prompt: The contract contains a clause about late payment. It is a clause ------- both parties objected.

choices.B: to which
choices.C: to that
choices.D: whose

questions.translationJa: 契約には支払い遅延に関する条項があります。双方が反対した条項です。
questions.explanationJa: object to the clauseのtoをwhichの前に置きます。

questions.prompt: Ms. Reed remained calm throughout the outage, ------- she usually does in emergencies.

choices.B: what
choices.C: who
choices.D: which

questions.translationJa: リードさんは障害中ずっと冷静さを保ちました。緊急時にはいつもそうします。
questions.explanationJa: whichはremained calmという行動内容を受け、doesがその動作を代用します。

questions.prompt: We received twenty survey responses. Neither ------- mentioned the new logo.

choices.B: which of
choices.C: of that
choices.D: whose

questions.translationJa: アンケート回答を20件受け取りましたが、そのどちらも新しいロゴには触れていませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: 提示された集合の中のゼロをneither of whichで受けます。

questions.prompt: The board postponed its decision until Monday, ------- gives us time to revise the forecast.

choices.B: which
choices.C: what
choices.D: when

questions.translationJa: 取締役会は決定を月曜日まで延期し、そのため予測を修正する時間ができました。
questions.explanationJa: whichは決定延期という前文内容全体を受け、givesの主語になります。
